Hi Sofia — thanks again for the call earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps so your procurement and security teams have what they need from us:

Summary of asks from your side:
- SOC 2 Type II report (most recent) and bridge letter if Type II period does not cover ongoing operations
- Confirmation of GDPR/HIPAA applicability for the engagement and whether Medicore will require a BAA
- Vendor security questionnaire (we saw the initial spreadsheet you mentioned) — we can populate but need the canonical file
- Trust portal invite so you can browse artifacts and evidence directly

What I can provide immediately:
- I will loop in our security and legal leads to share the SOC 2 Type II report and a bridge letter (if applicable).
- We can provision a temporary read-only trust portal account for Medicore procurement and security within 24 business hours.

Proposed timeline:
1) Please confirm the primary procurement contact + any additional security reviewers (names/emails).
2) Confirm whether a BAA is required. If yes, we will initiate our standard BAA review (legal cc'd).
3) If you send the vendor questionnaire file, Marcus will populate and return within 48 hours.

If that looks good I will pull together the materials and send the portal invite.

Thanks,
